Seedcamp was early/pre-seed backer. Domain verified.

Verified domain thosebeyond.io; formerly Cauldron (cauldron.co) — London immersive/fan-engagement studio (Mark Warrick, Fox Rogers, Matt Hyde; Thought Machine spinout). Mixed USD/GBP so amount_raised left empty rather than inventing a FX total; disclosed equity is $8.0M + £1.2M.
